name: Sydney
summary: Central Sydney: 7,962 buildings, the Opera House and Harbour Bridge, sun access on protected public places, and a game: walk it, ride the ferries, fly under the bridge.

name: Melbourne
tagline: Docklands, the Hoddle Grid and Southbank to the Shrine
summary: Central Melbourne from Docklands to the Shrine: 13,050 buildings on Geoscience Australia's 5 m LiDAR terrain, the Arts Centre spire, and sun on the public spaces the planning scheme protects.

group_info.summary: Two districts of Melbourne on Geoscience Australia's LiDAR terrain: the city centre from Docklands to the Shrine, and Port Phillip's shore from St Kilda to Brighton, where little penguins come ashore after sunset.

name: Melbourne Bayside
tagline: St Kilda, Elwood and Brighton on Port Phillip
summary: Port Phillip's shore from St Kilda to Brighton: 9,335 buildings, the 96 Brighton bathing boxes, Luna Park's Scenic Railway, and a game where little penguins come ashore on the St Kilda breakwater after sunset.

group_info.summary: Two districts of Melbourne on Geoscience Australia's LiDAR terrain: the city centre from Docklands to the Shrine, and Port Phillip's shore from St Kilda to Brighton, where little penguins come ashore after sunset.

name: Osaka
summary: Umeda to Shinsekai along Midosuji, with Osaka Castle: 73,000 buildings, 89% of the roof area with a height measured for Project PLATEAU, the Dotonbori neon, a winter-sun study of the parks, and a game with Osaka people.

name: Kyoto
summary: Central Kyoto, Kyoto Station to the Imperial Palace: 66,000 buildings with measured heights from Project PLATEAU, GSI laser terrain, and a game: walk the city with Kyoto people.

name: Tokyo
tagline: Tokyo Station, the Imperial Palace, Hibiya and Shiba
summary: Marunouchi to Tokyo Tower: 15,000 buildings, 76% of the footprint area at a PLATEAU-surveyed height, Tokyo Tower built to its published dimensions, and a game: Tokyo Station, the Palace, Hibiya Park, the water bus and a helicopter to the tower.

group_info.summary: Two districts of Tokyo at PLATEAU-surveyed heights: Marunouchi to Tokyo Tower, with the Palace and the water bus, and Shibuya to Shinjuku, with the scramble, SHIBUYA SKY's roof and the streets a film and a game drew.

name: Shibuya & Shinjuku
tagline: Sangenjaya to the scramble, Shinjuku and Yotsuya
summary: Sangenjaya to Shibuya, Shinjuku and Yotsuya: 90,000 buildings at PLATEAU-surveyed heights, the Shibuya scramble, SHIBUYA SKY's roof with its lift and escalator, the Suga Shrine stairs of Your Name with this year's ema, and the streets Persona 5 drew, from Sangenjaya's backstreets to Kabukicho.

group_info.summary: Two districts of Tokyo at PLATEAU-surveyed heights: Marunouchi to Tokyo Tower, with the Palace and the water bus, and Shibuya to Shinjuku, with the scramble, SHIBUYA SKY's roof and the streets a film and a game drew.

name: Whitsundays
summary: The Whitsunday Islands and the inner Great Barrier Reef: 30 m survey bathymetry, a Sentinel-2 sea floor, caustics, wet sand and a swash line. Walk Whitehaven Beach, snorkel, dive.
tagline: Whitehaven Beach, Hill Inlet and the Whitsunday Passage

group_info.summary: Five sites on the Great Barrier Reef, rebuilt from survey bathymetry and satellite imagery under the real sun, moon and tide. Walk, snorkel, dive, sail and fly.

name: Hardy Reef
tagline: Heart Reef and the Reefworld pontoon, outer reef
summary: Hardy Reef on the outer Great Barrier Reef: Heart Reef, the Reefworld pontoon on the channel wall, and Hook, Line and Bait reefs, from 30 m survey bathymetry and Sentinel-2. No land: start on the pontoon's deck and dive the wall.

group_info.summary: Five sites on the Great Barrier Reef, rebuilt from survey bathymetry and satellite imagery under the real sun, moon and tide. Walk, snorkel, dive, sail and fly.

name: Green Island
tagline: Coral cay off Cairns, with Arlington Reef and Michaelmas Cay
summary: Green Island, a coral cay 27 km off Cairns, with Arlington Reef, Upolu Cay and Michaelmas Cay: survey bathymetry, a seam-free Sentinel-2 sea floor and MSQ's tide. Walk the beach by the jetty, snorkel the reef flat.

group_info.summary: Five sites on the Great Barrier Reef, rebuilt from survey bathymetry and satellite imagery under the real sun, moon and tide. Walk, snorkel, dive, sail and fly.

name: Heron Island
tagline: Coral cay on the Tropic of Capricorn, with Wistari Reef
summary: Heron Island and Heron and Wistari reefs in the southern Great Barrier Reef: the cay rebuilt from its mapped outline, the reef flat drying at low tide, the research station and the wreck of HMCS Protector at the channel.

group_info.summary: Five sites on the Great Barrier Reef, rebuilt from survey bathymetry and satellite imagery under the real sun, moon and tide. Walk, snorkel, dive, sail and fly.

name: Lady Elliot Island
tagline: The southernmost coral cay of the reef
summary: Lady Elliot Island, the southernmost coral cay of the Great Barrier Reef: its platform reef in open water, the airstrip and old lighthouse, from survey bathymetry and Sentinel-2. Start on the western beach.

group_info.summary: Five sites on the Great Barrier Reef, rebuilt from survey bathymetry and satellite imagery under the real sun, moon and tide. Walk, snorkel, dive, sail and fly.

name: New York
data: NYC Open Data footprints with LiDAR roof heights; USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM; NYS orthoimagery.

name: London
data: Environment Agency 1 m LiDAR DTM (OGL); OSM heights; open aerial imagery still to find.

name: Paris
summary: Central Paris from the Eiffel Tower to the Île Saint-Louis: every roof measured by IGN's airborne LiDAR, zinc mansards with their dormers and chimney stacks, the Seine's bridges, and a game: ride the Batobus and fly under the Eiffel Tower.

name: Amsterdam
summary: Central Amsterdam from the IJ to Museumplein: every building the 3DBAG's model of it, measured by the national LiDAR, canal houses with the gable of their century, the church towers, and a game: read the gables, cross the IJ on the free ferry, find the winter sun.

name: Hong Kong
summary: Victoria Harbour from Central to Tsim Sha Tsui and the Peak: 7,513 buildings, nearly all at the heights the Lands Department surveyed, checked against a 2020 LiDAR scan; the Bank of China Tower, HSBC and the Star Ferry; and a game: ride the ferry and the Peak Tram.

name: Singapore
data: OSM footprints and heights; open bare-earth DEM and imagery still to find.
